title: Sephora Shoplifters Caught After Stealing $1000 in Makeup Products
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 27th, 2023. Officers were called to Sephora regarding two females who were caught shoplifting over a $1000 in makeup products. The store manager said that one female was actively stealing all the products while the other was just on the lookout and actively shielding her from cameras. When the store employees caught them, they tried to leave the basket and walk away however they brought to the back office for questioning. When the officer conducted an interview on them it was later discovered that one of the females gave a fake name and had violated her probation. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
